aboutBlock.title: About us?
aboutBlock.p1: HackChain is an educational-labor ecosystem that links Talent, Educators, and Recruiters in order to promote constant learning and transparency in recruitment processes.
aboutBlock.p2: We believe Web3 technology should be accessible, decentralized, and designed to empower real users. Our goal is to accompany professionals in their growth with immutable tools and credentials that truly make a difference.
aboutBlock.p3: Our vision is to become the global standard for talent verification, creating a world where every acquired skill is recognized globally without barriers or intermediaries, effectively bridging the gap between education and employment.
